name: Stealing
overview: Scripture clearly commands against stealing, as stated in Exodus 20:15 and reiterated in Leviticus 19:11. The Bible addresses the consequences of theft, requiring restitution, such as paying double for stolen money or goods (Exodus 22:7). Believers are warned against placing trust in ill-gotten wealth or oppression (Psalms 62:10), and are reminded that righteousness, not wicked gain, brings true deliverance (Proverbs 10:2). These teachings emphasize the holiness of God's law and the importance of integrity in the believer's life.
